{{verse|chapter=6|verse=60|align=float}}† Many therfore of his Di{{ls}}ciples hearing it, {{ls}}aid, This {{ls}}aying is hard, and vvho can heare it? {{verse|chapter=6|verse=61|align=float}}† But {{sc|Iesvs}} knovving vvith him {{ls}}elf that his Di{{ls}}ciples murmured at this, he {{ls}}aid to them, Doth this {{ls}}candalize you? {{verse|chapter=6|verse=62|align=float}}† {{sup|‖}} If then you {{ls}}hal {{ls}}ee * {{outside L|''Io. 3, 13.''}} the Sonne of man a{{ls}}cend vvhere he vvas before? {{verse|chapter=6|verse=63|align=float}}† It is the {{ls}}pirit that quickeneth, {{sup|‖}} the fle{{ls}}h profiteth nothing. The wordes that I haue {{ls}}poken to you, be {{ls}}pirit and life. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=64|align=float}}† But there be certaine of you {{sup|‖}} that beleeue not. For {{sc|Iesvs}} knevv from the beginning vvho they vvere that did not beleeue, and vvho he vvas that vvould betray him. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=65|align=float}}† And he {{ls}}aid, Therfore did I {{ls}}ay to you, that no man can come to me, vnles it be giuen him of my Father. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=66|align=float}}† After this many of his Di{{ls}}ciples {{sup|‖}} vvent backe: and novv they vvalked not vvith him.

{{verse|chapter=6|verse=67|align=float}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore {{ls}}aid to the Tvvelue, VVhat, vvil you al{{ls}}o depart? {{verse|chapter=6|verse=68|align=float}}† Simon {{sup|‖}} Peter therfore an{{ls}}vvered him, Lord, to vvhom {{ls}}hal vve goe? thou ha{{ls}}t the vvordes of eternal life. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=69|align=float}}† And we beleeue and haue knovven that thou art Chri{{ls}}t the {{ls}}onne of God. {{verse|chapter=6|verse=70|align=float}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} an{{ls}}vvered them, Haue not I cho{{ls}}en you the Tvvelue: & of you one is a deuil? {{verse|chapter=6|verse=71|align=float}}† And he meant Iudas I{{ls}}cariot, Simons {{ls}}onne: for this {{ls}}ame vvas to betray him, vvhereas he vvas one of the Tvvelue.
